description: Curated benchmark corpus of pinned, public open-source Next.js applications with App Router, Server Actions, and React Server Component boundaries.

repositories.name: shadcn-ui/taxonomy
repositories.description: An open-source Next.js 13/14 App Router reference application with Server Components, Route Handlers, and Server Actions.
repositories.notes: Provides standard Next.js App Router idioms, contentlayer markdown pipelines, and server actions.

repositories.name: leerob/site
repositories.description: Lee Robinson's personal portfolio and blog built with Next.js App Router, Server Actions, Postgres, and RSC.
repositories.notes: High-fidelity production site by VP of DevRel with pure App Router patterns, guestbook Server Actions, and Postgres queries.

repositories.name: vercel/commerce
repositories.description: Vercel's official Next.js Commerce architecture template with App Router, Server Actions for cart management, and dynamic RSC.
repositories.notes: Official modern Next.js commerce template exercising Shopify integration, cookie management, and cart Server Actions.

repositories.name: dubinc/dub
repositories.description: Open-source link management platform with multi-tenant App Router, Server Actions, complex Zod validation, and Prisma ORM.
repositories.notes: Large-scale real-world production application with sophisticated Server Action argument schemas, authentication, and multi-tenancy.

repositories.name: mickasmt/next-saas-stripe-starter
repositories.description: Open-source SaaS starter featuring Next.js App Router, Server Actions for account management and Stripe billing, and Prisma.
repositories.notes: Representative production SaaS foundation with Stripe webhooks, user settings Server Actions, and auth guards.
